extracted.intended_audience: general readers and students of classic literature (readers of Cervantes' Don Quixote), especially those interested in comic/picaresque prose
extracted.subtask_description: This is an excerpt from Miguel de Cervantes' Don Quixote, a comic picaresque novel. The text is intended for readers studying or enjoying episodic knight-errant parody, humor, and narrative voice in early modern Spanish literature (English translation).
